mechanism: Immutable network.serviceWorker profile omits ServiceWorkerContextCore, its registry initialization and non-network update-check loader bundle/prewarm. Retains wrapper, observer lists and process manager required by navigation/lifecycle. Native window/dedicated-worker getters reject before acquisition; native journal preserves caught violations. Selected DevTools mutation and service-worker clearing commands reject before effects. CacheStorage, other storage, ordinary network and worker services remain enabled.
scope: Fresh ephemeral contexts only; no persistent profile with prior service-worker registrations. Ordinary service-worker interception is separately verified in full mode. Availability-only prototype/presence probes are preserved. This is one network capability, not the complete proposed contract.

runnerCoverage: caught native failure becomes an expected failed attempt
retry keeps the frozen declaration and fresh storage
declaration input mutation cannot broaden the copied contract

timingPolicy.primaryMetric: Original watchdog elapsedSeconds including application server startup, unchanged runner execution, and observed shutdown. Source generation/dependency/browser acquisition precedes all owner captures.

Otherwise retain functionality without advancing this omission alone for broad speed leadership.
limitations: Fresh browser per attempt in both arms for native journal custody; does not represent well-configured ordinary Playwright browser reuse.

limitations: Default dedicated workers remain functional and lack the experimental serviceWorker API. Enabling that API hangs in the full-mode control on both the preceding and new browser; no functional admission for that experimental feature. The excluded getter was separately observed rejecting before its provider path.
Flashwright popup event waiting and public DevTools sessions remain unsupported; corresponding native controls use Playwright.
File journals, process-global policy and Linux no-sandbox execution remain private prototypes; production IPC, broader network/storage boundaries, portable packaging and final release gates are open.
Fresh browser per attempt adds costs unrelated to feature omission; these timings cannot establish a win against ordinary well-configured Playwright.
Selected source/runtime bindings and observed group drain do not establish exhaustive process custody. Five writer PIDs escaped the functional sampler.
The reused raw application verifier contains a generic drawing/DOM-storage profile description; actual frozen declarations and native policies verified here omit only network.serviceWorker.
No backend application refresh in this screen.
decision: Retain the real service-worker omission and selected strict enforcement. Do not admit this screen: one guardian cleanup failed, and no complete application/worker cell meets the predeclared speed threshold in both blocks. Diagnose the cleanup failure without replacing its sample; this one subsystem does not test the whole capability idea.
